notes: Torah #88 has zero cause/effect (eitza or cause-type) edges in the dataset. The existing bechina packages contain 4 nodes across 2 packages (Package 1: מטר, השפעות וברכות; Package 2: שכינה, אלהים). The source text does contain implicit causal relationships — notably, the tzaddik concealing his love/fear (שמים=אהבה ויראה) CAUSES the influx (מטר=השפעות) to descend, and the מקטרגים BLOCK the influx — but these are not yet recorded as edges in the dataset. No enrichment is possible until cause/effect edges are added to torahData.js for this Torah.
